Control of the prediction of a regionalized surface

Source: R/regionalize-methods.R
ef_predict_control.Rd

Settings of the grid prediction of ef_regionalize() (dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 6.1): exact prediction at every cell, computed by blocks of raster rows. None of the settings changes the values; they only bound memory and choose where the surfaces are written.

Usage

ef_predict_control(
  mode = "exact",
  block_rows = NULL,
  chunk_rows = 10000L,
  filename = "",
  flags_filename = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  wopt = list()
)

Arguments

mode

Character. Only "exact" (one local fit per cell) is implemented; the coarse mode of dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 6.2 (decision GW-08) is not.

block_rows

NULL or a whole number: raster rows per block. NULL uses the blocks proposed by terra::writeStart() (split further, when a parallel plan is set, so that every worker receives blocks).

chunk_rows

Whole number: cells processed together inside a block by ef_gwr_predict() (memory only).

filename

Character. File of the surface; "" lets terra keep it in memory (or in its own temporary file when it does not fit).

flags_filename

NULL or character: file of the flag word layers. NULL derives it from filename (<name>_flags.<ext>), or keeps the layers in memory when filename is "".

overwrite

Logical. Overwrite existing files.

wopt

List of write options passed to terra::writeStart() for the surface (e.g. list(datatype = "FLT8S"); terra writes FLT4S by default, decision D-PP-05). The flag words are always written as INT4S.

Value

A list of class "earthflux_predict_control".

Details

Errors: earthflux_unknown_method (mode), earthflux_input_error (types), earthflux_domain_error (non-positive sizes).

See also

Other spatial regionalization functions: ef_gwr_bandwidth(), ef_gwr_diagnostics(), ef_gwr_fit(), ef_gwr_predict(), ef_gwr_search(), ef_method_gwr(), ef_method_idw(), ef_method_ols(), ef_method_station(), ef_regionalize(), ef_regionalize_cv(), ef_spatial_folds()

Examples

ef_predict_control()
#> <earthflux_predict_control>
#> Mode: exact; block rows: terra; chunk rows: 10000
#> Surface: memory; flags: memory
ef_predict_control(block_rows = 50,
                   filename = file.path(tempdir(), "ta.tif"),
                   wopt = list(datatype = "FLT8S"))
#> <earthflux_predict_control>
#> Mode: exact; block rows: 50; chunk rows: 10000
#> Surface: /tmp/RtmpYccaED/ta.tif; flags: /tmp/RtmpYccaED/ta_flags.tif
